description: Find labels that still need translation on a branch. For each key with at least one empty target-language value, returns { key, source: { lang, value }, missing: [languages] }, where the source language is the project's first configured language. Optionally restrict to specific `languages` and cap the rows with `limit` (default 200); the response reports the true total and notes truncation. Use this to translate the missing values YOURSELF (works on any plan) and then write them back with upsert_labels. For server-side AI on paid plans, use auto_translate instead. Reads the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

languages.description: Restrict to these target languages; omit to check every non-source project language.

name: get_missing_translations
title: Find Missing Translations
